To Whom It May Concern,  

I’ve collaborated daily with Ulrich Weber for over two years as part of our analytics team at Weber Consulting. As a Data Engineer, he’s been instrumental in scaling our client data infrastructure while maintaining high reliability.  

Ulrich’s strengths lie in his ability to balance technical precision with business alignment. He consistently delivers robust ETL pipelines that meet strict SLAs, such as reducing data latency by 40% for a healthcare client last quarter. His Python automation scripts have cut manual reporting tasks by 30%, freeing analysts to focus on insights. While his toolset includes Snowflake and Apache Airflow, he prioritizes solutions that align with client ecosystems, often bridging gaps between legacy systems and modern platforms.  

A standout example occurred during a financial compliance project. When a client’s data warehouse faced unexpected downtime, Ulrich rearchitected the pipeline within 48 hours, leveraging his familiarity with data warehousing principles to restore operations without data loss. His proactive approach to monitoring and alerting ensured minimal disruption.  

Ulrich’s reliability and technical depth make him a critical asset. He thrives in complex environments and consistently exceeds expectations.  

Sincerely,
